title: Typst letters, document pipeline and Bedrock agent
summary: Rocky writes DIN 5008 letters as PDFs straight into the Slack thread, ingests and reconciles documents, and now runs its agent loop on Bedrock.

sections.heading: New
items: generate_letter tool renders DIN 5008 form B PDFs via Typst and posts them into the Slack thread as drafts, with three templates: allgemein, Mieterhöhung, Mahnung
Document pipeline: upload, OCR, classify, search, compare and reconcile, filed in the docs bucket alongside inbound documents
Scheduled jobs can run compound web research
Interests scoring and a story log

sections.heading: Improved
items: Agent loop moved from Groq to Bedrock (100M TPM at the same model cost)
Slack replies use informal German and skip markdown tables
Letter values pass through a single escaped interpolation point; the layout itself is a static string

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Linux Typst binary vendored so letter rendering works on Lambda
generate_letter accepts an explicit recipient address
Tool results are logged, and Hacker News no longer stands in for non tech subreddits
